title: Usage tools
summary: Cost and usage reports built from your local Claude transcripts.
benefit: You see where your tokens and money go, per project and tool.
details: Three node scripts build cost and usage reports from your local Claude transcripts: per-account API-equivalent cost for a time window (last 7 days by default), a usage percent series, and a transcript audit. You fill tools/usage-config.json with each account's label, the first 8 characters of its organization id and its config folder, then run a script when you want a report. They run only when you start them, read local transcripts and send nothing out; times are shown in UTC+4.
trigger: Run the report scripts in ~/.claude/tools when you want a cost or usage report.
user_steps: Fill ~/.claude/tools/usage-config.json: for each account a label, the first 8 characters of its organization id (oauthAccount.organizationUuid in ~/.claude.json) and its config folder relative to your home folder.

With a second Claude profile, add a second entry to ~/.claude/tools/usage-config.json (label, first 8 characters of its organization id, config folder). With one account, delete the second example entry.
risk: Runs only when you start it; it reads your local transcripts and sends nothing out. The detail sections cover the first account, times are shown in UTC+4.
